name: The Noric Republic's field army on the south-western border
status: F3.1 (20 Nov 2026): data only (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md sections 8 and 11). Nothing reads it on the campaign path until F3.3; simcore/ground_war/ground_data.hpp loads it and tests/test_ground_data.cpp checks it.
source: SAM3D estimate: a neutral's doctrine is dissuasion on its own territory (sadauer_schlup_1978 pp. 54, 88-90); in the war's fiction it makes a limited incursion to its political depth (the faction's politics max_depth_km, 40 km) and then holds. The owner's open decision 2 taken as proposed (docs/fronts/README.md)
notes: One mechanised division of three brigades and two territorial regiments to hold what it takes. No exploitation. All numbers placeholders.
